provenance.construction: Central CSS tensor product (Eqs. 14-15 of arXiv:2609.37231) of the Lin-Pryadko [[84,14,10]] 2BGA code on SmallGroup(42,3), reconstructed on this board by @MathysRennela, with the all-ones [[6,4,2]] CSS amplifier. A sparse independent subset of 35 rows per base-check side gives n=6*84+35+35=574 and k=4*14=56.
